newsitem.title: USA: Washington Mutual to pledge loans - paper.
newsitem.headline: Washington Mutual to pledge loans - paper.

text.p: Washington Mutual, in a takeover fight with H.F. Ahmanson to aquire Great Western Financial, is expected to announce a large commitment for low income loans if it merges with Great Western, the Los Angeles Times said.
Washington Mutual is seen announcing a commitment to lend $75 billion to mostly low-income and minority borrowers over 10 years if the merger goes through, the paper said Thursday.
The company was quoted in the paper as saying most of the mortgage, consumer and small business loans would be made in California.

On March 20, Ahmanson's Home Savings of America announced a $70 billion, 10-year community commitment. Ahmanson's Chief Executive Charles Rinehart said if the merger did not go through, the pledge would fall to about half that amount.
